title: Chapter 203 Blood Refining
content:
Chapter 203 Blood Refining

Chenggao County is the border between Qin State and South Korea, and it is also an important pass that prevents the six Kanto countries from attacking. As an important town in the east of Qin State, the importance of Chenggao County is self-evident.

Today's Chenggao County is home to South Korea, the Kingdom of Yan and the Kingdom of Yu, with a total of 350,000 troops from the Allied Forces of the Three Kingdoms. In the county town, there are 300,000 Qin State's eastward army led by Wang Jian, and 50,000 county guards from Sanchuan County.

The battle clouds between the two sides are dense, and the wind and rain are unstoppable in the future.

But apart from the chilling atmosphere on the battlefield and the 10,000 limitless fighters, there was also a group of people in black, wandering around on the battlefield, as if they were looking for something.

"Captain, we've found that location. It's no different from the instructions given to us!" A man in black with a bronze mask on his face said to a more majestic man in front of him.

"Well, just find it. My lord takes this action very seriously. It is said that His Majesty is leading it personally. If we can do it well, there will be many opportunities for promotion!" The mighty man nodded in satisfaction, and turned to himself The subordinate encouraged.

"Yes, this subordinate promises to complete the task, so I will go to find another location!" The subordinate was excited after hearing the encouragement from his superior, and after a salute with a tall and straight figure, he hurried to another place and continued to work. up.

These people are none other than the extremely private secret guards of Yu Kingdom.

As the largest hidden dark force in the imperial kingdom, the responsibilities of the dark guards are extremely arduous, and they are usually understaffed to handle those busy trivial matters.

Today he actually sent hundreds of people to this battlefield, wandering around, as if they had nothing to do, it is really unbelievable.

Even if the two armies are at war now, a secret confrontation is essential, but in broad daylight, this kind of investigation work should be handed over to their respective scouts, not by these secret guards hiding in the dark.

There must be a reason for things to go wrong.

These comforts, the reason why they appeared in this place was mainly because they received an order, an order that they could not refuse.

Who can make these people who are usually fearless, even in the face of those high-ranking officials of the Yu Kingdom, they are neither humble nor overbearing, even the hidden guards with a little arrogance.

In the entire world, apart from the current emperor of Yu Kingdom, His Majesty Zhong Yu, who can give this order.

The reason why they are gathered here now is to shoulder a arduous task, which is to arrange an extremely huge formation on this battlefield.

Although this formation is extremely large in scale, it takes a long time, and consumes a lot of precious resources. Since the system disappeared, the rare materials in Yuguo's reserves have been used less and less, but now they are willing to spend them. This shows that the emperor of Yuguo is very concerned about this matter of importance.

So, what is the use of this formation? The scope covers hundreds of miles around, and the ability to use is not to mention the fact that there are hundreds of hidden guards on the battlefield, and there are many more people who don't know what to do, which contributes to them one after another. the power of.

Before the system disappeared, Zhong Yu learned about a method called blood refining from the system, that is, useless lonely souls on the battlefield use their blood and souls to refine weapons.

The weapons sacrificed through this method possessed a strong bloody evil spirit, and also contained a killing spirit unique to the army, which had an extremely powerful restraint effect on everything in the world.

Moreover, this kind of sacrificially refined weapon does not require very precious materials at the beginning, even ordinary iron, or some other things, such as precious thousand-year-old trees or ten-thousand-year boulders, are all needed. Yes, there are no hard requirements.

And after these weapons are sacrificed and refined, they will follow their masters to kill more people and kill more powerful people. They will continue to absorb the essence of those people and grow slowly. It can be said that their potential is unlimited.

Of course, using some good materials at the beginning will be of great help to his future growth. It can speed up his growth and reduce a lot of energy for it to advance. There are still advantages.

As the emperor of the empire, he wanted to build a weapon that could match his identity. Naturally, the materials he used would not be easy, but he cherished them extremely.

He directly took out all the materials stored in the treasury that could be used to forge weapons, and forged a long sword together according to the best ratio provided by the craftsmen, and sent the long sword to the battlefield, and handed it over to the leader of the dark guard Check it out yourself.

This long sword will be in the center of the battlefield and the center of the entire formation in the future, serving as the hub.

And in the entire battlefield, all the dead battle spirits will be continuously gathered into this long sword through the formation, so that under the blessing of the formation, the long sword will be devoured and refined without moving, becoming The nourishment of this long sword made him grow continuously, turning into the power of the long sword.

As a peerless fierce blade, it is naturally impossible to only devour the soul, and the blood essence in the human body is also his goal.

Devouring the flesh and blood in the corpse on a large scale, in addition to causing a huge abnormality, is also time-consuming and labor-intensive, and the gain outweighs the gain.

After all, the energy essence contained in ordinary flesh and blood is extremely rare and full of impurities, so it is not taken by people of insight.

Except for those who were born in the wild with no school and no background, they would choose this method that is not only easy to expose, but also has little effect.

The real disciples of the sect go to those strong men, or the few drops of blood in the bodies of ordinary people, and absorb the essence that is really contained in their bodies.

With the great help of the system before, Zhong Yu, who has obtained many secrets of exercises and precious secrets, naturally chose the most efficient method of absorbing essence and blood.

In this way, it is not easy to cause the discovery of the countries, and it can greatly hide their goals. Even if they are aware of their actions and feel a little uneasy, how can they, as mortals, understand that this is extremely precious to those who are cultivators? Methods.

All the arrangements are proceeding in an orderly manner, and all the forces of the Yu Kingdom in the six kingdoms of Shandong are continuously gathered on the battlefield for the establishment of this magic circle.

Such a large-scale transfer of personnel, and the transfers are all well-trained and powerful secret guards, who are considered small masters in the world, it is difficult to get the attention of all the snobbish people in the world.

The secret agents of one force after another gathered on the battlefield continuously, following those people's mobilization, closely following them, checking their footsteps, and seeing what they were trying to do?
